notes.title: Technical difficulties.
notes.notes:
Good evening.

Earlier this morning one of our computer's hard disk failed and everything on it went to ashes. Streamline and many other future projects disappeared, it is a huge mistake of us too not take daily backups of our work.

We are not the once who has taken the most damage of this loss, it's you. The players, we are supposed to give you exciting content and updates but we cant anymore, and for that we are really sorry about.

We are currently checking all of our servers and external devices for any backups that we may have taken, but at this day it's dark.

We will reduce the price of Streamline to $2.99 in the future as we cant supply new content.

Hopefully, with the latest update we got enough content to fulfill some players needs of entertainment.


Sincerely, Frostcloud studio staff.

notes.title: 27/08/15 - Streamline v2.0 released.
notes.notes:
[b]With the help of our community feedback we are happy to present to you v2.0 of Streamline, featuring more dynamic gameplay.[/b]

[h1]What's new:[/h1]

[list][*]Added a second layer of cubes above the starting platform.

[*]Cubes have been made larger for a more running experience.

[*]Cubes have been given a certain amount of HP which is different depending on the difficulty being played.

[*]Double jump aswell as a wallrunning has been added. (note that the wallrunning will only work on the large walls.)

[*]We are happy with the results of these changes and we would like to thank you for being a part of Streamline's development. [/list]

Happy gaming!
